The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹115 for next year compared to ₹96.09 last year.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹96.09 (up from ₹75.65 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹119.1b (up 22% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹9.18b (up 32% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.7% (up from 7.2% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) surpassed analyst estimates by 2.5%. Revenue is forecast to grow 17% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 19% growth forecast for the Electrical industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 19% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 38% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹24.57 (up from ₹17.87 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹29.5b (up 20% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.35b (up 43% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.9% (up from 6.7% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 2.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 1.9%. Revenue is forecast to grow 19% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 20% growth forecast for the Electrical industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 19% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 35% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: KEI Industries Limited Approves Reconstitution of Risk Management Committee
news.body: KEI Industries Limited approved reconstitution of Risk Management Committee and their composition shall be as under with effect from January 22, 2026. Risk Management Committee: Shri Sadhu Ram Bansal (Chairman), Independent Director; Shri Anil Gupta (Member), Non-Independent Executive Director; Dr. Rajesh Kumar Yaduvanshi (Member), Independent Director; and Shri Vinay Mittal (Member), Independent Director.

news.title: KEI Industries Limited Announces Declaration of Interim Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body:
KEI Industries Limited Declaration of Interim Dividend of INR 4.50/- (i.e. @ 225%) per Equity Share of face value of INR 2.00/- each for the Financial Year 2025-26, pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 43 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Further as per Regulation 42 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Record Date for the purpose of determining the Equity Shareholders entitled
to receive the interim dividend for the financial year 2025-26, has been fixed as Wednesday, the 28th day of January, 2026, at the board meeting held on January 21, 2026.
